dialogues.speaker: Tzompantli
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to the "Street Fighting Fontainian" instrument shop!

dialogues.speaker: Tzompantli
dialogues.text: It's the name of my favorite song from Fontaine. After our war against the Abyss ended, I was lucky enough to visit Fontaine, and I got to listen to a type of music they call rock 'n' roll.

dialogues.speaker: Tzompantli
dialogues.text: When I heard such exhilarating tunes like "Hydrostruck," "Street Fighting Fontainian," and "Wake Me Up When the Fontinalia Festival Ends," it made me realize...

dialogues.speaker: Tzompantli
dialogues.text: This was what I'd been searching for all my life — a type of music to surpass my tribe's own.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why were you searching for something to surpass the Children of Echoes' music?

dialogues.speaker: Tzompantli
dialogues.text: If you'd like some advice from me, my friend, you're better off not listening to the Children of Echoes' music.

dialogues.speaker: Tzompantli
dialogues.text: I'm from the Children of Echoes myself, and while I'll proudly say our music is exceptional, I'd also argue you should refuse to listen to it. Why? Because it'll only distract you from listening to rock!

dialogues.speaker: Tzompantli
dialogues.text: What a pity. Looks like we're not singing from the same sheet.

dialogues.speaker: Tzompantli
dialogues.text: Great! I knew we were singing from the same sheet.

dialogues.speaker: Tzompantli
dialogues.text: Just for that, I'm gonna offer you an honorary membership at "Street Fighting Fontainians"! I'll make sure you get a discount on everything in the store. All I need from you is a 50,000 Mora registration fee, and...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No thanks. I think I'm gonna rock 'n' roll right out of here.
